title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-05
source: SBD > REEL > REEL > DAT > SP/DIF > HD > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a scorching 1969 show highlighted by an electric “Mountains of the Moon > Dark Star” and a soaring St. Stephen → Lovelight transition.
ai_review.review: The SBD is praised as crisp, sweet and clearer than other copies, delivering a vivid listening experience. Musically the concert is described as near‑perfect, with standout moments from Dupree, Mountains of the Moon into Dark Star, St. Stephen/Lovelight, The Eleven and Pigpen‑driven blues jams that epitomize the era’s psychedelic edge.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 5 stars) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and soundboard quality indicate an exceptional show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note a crisp, sweet board that is clearer than other uploads; no significant flaws mentioned.

standout_songs: Mountains of the Moon > Dark Star
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows seamlessly with acoustic‑electric segues and extended jams, capturing the psychedelic vibe of 1969 while maintaining strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as sharp, on‑the‑edge playing with a powerful guitar tone during the Dark Star and jam sections.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s vocal/organ presence highlighted on Hard to Handle and the overall “Pig style” feel of the show.
